new.name: RECOGNIZES_INCOMPLETE_OBSERVATION
new.definition: The reasoning identifies that an observation presents only a partial portion of the relevant information and that the remaining portion still needs to be retrieved.

parameters.name: partial_view_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that notes the observation is partial or truncated.

parameters.name: incomplete_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing only a limited or selected portion of the relevant information.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains only an initial, limited, or selected portion of the information being sought.
The reasoning explicitly notes that the observation is incomplete or that further content remains to be inspected.
The missing portion is relevant to the reasoning's current information need.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning requests an unrelated additional piece of information without treating the observation as incomplete.
The observation already contains the complete information needed.
The reasoning only summarizes or repeats the observed content without recognizing a missing portion.

new.name: RETRIEVES_MISSING_SECTION_WITH_FOLLOWUP
new.definition: A follow-up action is deliberately scoped to retrieve the portion of information absent from a prior incomplete observation, and the resulting observation supplies that previously missing portion.

parameters.name: gap_reasoning
parameters.description: Reasoning identifying the specific information missing from a prior partial observation.

parameters.name: followup_action
parameters.description: The action targeted at retrieving the missing section or range of information.

parameters.name: followup_observation
parameters.description: The result that supplies the previously missing information.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific missing section or range of information in a prior partial observation.
The follow-up action targets that missing section or range rather than repeating the entire retrieval.
The follow-up observation contains the information that was identified as missing.
exclusion_conditions: The follow-up action is unrelated to the identified missing portion.
The follow-up action merely re-fetches the same complete information already available.
The follow-up observation does not address the missing content identified in the reasoning.

new.name: APPLIES_DISCOVERED_CAPABILITY
new.definition: An action applies a capability, option, method, or resource that was identified in an observation and selected in reasoning for the current task.

parameters.name: capability_observation
parameters.description: The observation disclosing a usable capability, option, method, or resource.

parameters.name: selection_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning selecting that disclosed capability for use.

parameters.name: application_action
parameters.description: The action that applies the selected capability to the task.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains an identifiable capability, option, method, or resource relevant to the task.
The reasoning selects that capability for use.
The action applies the selected capability in a way that corresponds to the observation and reasoning.
exclusion_conditions: The action uses a default or previously known method that was not identified in the observation.
The observation merely reports the result of an action rather than disclosing a usable capability.
The reasoning mentions a capability but the action does not apply it.

new.name: SYNTHESIZES_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE
new.definition: The reasoning combines multiple independently observed check results into a unified conclusion about satisfaction of the task's requirements.

parameters.name: synthesis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that draws the unified conclusion from multiple observations.

parameters.name: supporting_observations
parameters.description: The collection of observed check results that jointly support the conclusion.

assertion_conditions: The synthesis reasoning refers to at least two distinct observed check results.
The conclusion depends on the combined coverage of those observations rather than on any single one alone.
The supporting observations collectively provide evidence for different aspects of the task requirements.
exclusion_conditions: The conclusion rests on a single observation or on multiple observations that are only repetitions of the same check.
The reasoning lists observed results without drawing a unified conclusion.
The observations are unrelated to the claimed satisfaction of requirements.

uncertain.name: IMPLEMENTS_PLANNED_ACTION
uncertain.definition: A recorded action executes a future operation that the reasoning explicitly selected or described as the next step.

parameters.name: plan_reasoning
parameters.description: Reasoning that states the intended operation or next step to perform.

parameters.name: planned_action
parameters.description: The action that executes the operation stated in the reasoning.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies a future operation to perform.
The action's operation corresponds semantically to the operation stated in the reasoning.
The correspondence is identifiable from the action arguments and the reasoning content, not merely from temporal adjacency.
exclusion_conditions: The action performs an operation that the reasoning did not mention or select.
The reasoning contains only a general goal without any selected operation.
The action repeats an earlier operation without being the step proposed in the reasoning.

uncertain.name: VERIFIES_REQUIREMENT_WITH_PROBE
uncertain.definition: A targeted check action tests whether a stated requirement or desired property holds, and the resulting observation provides evidence for judging that requirement.

parameters.name: requirement_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the requirement, property, or uncertainty to be checked.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action performing the targeted check.

parameters.name: probe_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result relevant to the requirement.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific requirement, property, or uncertainty to be checked.
The probe action performs a check that specifically exercises or inspects the relevant artifact, behavior, or condition.
The probe observation reports a result that can be interpreted as supporting or refuting the requirement.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the stated requirement.
The observation does not address the requirement being checked.
The check is only attempted or executed without any observed result relevant to the requirement.
